title: Error model architecture decision
description: Cross-project decisions for the HTTP error model: media type, RFC reference, type URI template, canonical error categories (with default HTTP status + FE handling hint), required ProblemDetail extension fields, and the catalogue of error codes per module. Source of truth for the rendered error-model.md document and (in future phases) for the generated GlobalExceptionHandler. D-064.

$comment.description: Free-text note for maintainers; not consumed by any generator.

media_type.description: MIME type of error responses. Always 'application/problem+json' for RFC 7807 compliance.

type_uri_template.description: URI template for the `type` field of ProblemDetail; may contain {{ var }} placeholders interpolated with project context (e.g. project_name) and `{code}` for the error code.

fe_action_hint.description: Hint for the frontend on how to present this category (e.g. show_field_marks, redirect_login, show_dialog_with_resolution). Used by the access layer to choose UI affordance.

extension_fields.description: ProblemDetail body extension fields beyond RFC 7807's standard (type/title/status/detail/instance). All live under the top-level `error` object.

type.description: Semantic type (string, uuid, ISO-8601, enum-of-categories, array<field-error>, object).

modules.description: Error code catalogue grouped by module prefix (mirrors permission-catalogue.arch.json modules where appropriate).

code.description: Full stable error code (e.g. 'cad.cliente.duplicado'). MUST start with `<prefix>.` (validated).

category.description: Category id; MUST exist in categories[*].id (validated).

title.description: Default human-readable message; FE may override via i18n keyed by `code`.

context_fields.description: Optional field names this error attaches under `error.context` for debugging or FE display.
